clusters.headline: Bareskrim Polri Questions Budi Arie Over Treason Case Allegations
aiSummaryBullets: Bareskrim Polri is conducting examinations regarding an alleged treason case involving the tapping of President Prabowo Subianto.
Former Minister of Communication and Information Budi Arie Setiadi was called for questioning alongside a former aide to Joko Widodo.

clusters.headline: Bareskrim Polri Finds Illegal Gold Mine Operation In Bogor
aiSummaryBullets: Police uncovered an illegal gold processing facility in Leuwiliang, Bogor, which was disguised as a cattle farm.
The number of miners trapped in the Pongkor area reached 27, with 13 fatalities confirmed and identified by authorities.

clusters.headline: DSI To Implement Single Export Portal For Strategic Commodities In 2027
aiSummaryBullets: Danantara Sumberdaya Indonesia (DSI) will launch the National Data & Intelligence (NADI) portal for strategic commodity exports on January 1, 2027.
The new system introduces a single-entry export process for coal, palm oil, and ferroalloy, requiring exporters to register beginning December 15, 2026.

clusters.headline: Prabowo Subianto Discusses Teacher Welfare During National Teacher Day
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto stated that the timeline for teacher salary increases remains uncertain despite previous acknowledgments.
The government plans to send 3,350 teachers for training abroad in 2027 and is developing 'Guru Studios' to support distance learning.

clusters.headline: Listyo Sigit Prabowo Reschedules Ethics Hearing Amid Wiretap Claims
aiSummaryBullets: The Police Code of Ethics Commission postponed the disciplinary hearing for Listyo Sigit Prabowo until next Monday.
The delay followed the officer's refusal to attend the session, which prompted criticism from legislative members regarding institutional accountability.

clusters.headline: Andi Amran Sulaiman Comments On Sugiono As Potential Vice President
aiSummaryBullets: Andi Amran Sulaiman expressed positive support for Sugiono as a potential vice presidential candidate for President Prabowo.
Medical examinations for both candidates were completed by a team of 25 doctors and the results were submitted to the MPR.

clusters.headline: Teen Student Silva Nur Intania Putri Dies After Attack In Malang
aiSummaryBullets: Silva Nur Intania Putri, a 17-year-old student at SMAN 7 Malang, died following a suspected physical assault.
Police have detained three suspects and are currently questioning eight witnesses to determine the circumstances of the incident.

clusters.headline: Indonesia Prepares Infrastructure And Logistics For Nataru 2027
aiSummaryBullets: Transportation authorities are conducting safety inspections on bus fleets and increasing train capacity for the upcoming holiday period.
State agencies and law enforcement are monitoring food markets to manage price fluctuations and ensure supply availability for residents.

clusters.headline: Agung Nugroho And Multiple Indonesian Entities Receive Awards
aiSummaryBullets: Pekanbaru Mayor Agung Nugroho was honored with a Real Estate Indonesia award for his efforts in the local housing sector.
BRI received seven HR Excellence Awards, with its director recognized for corporate leadership focused on personnel development.

clusters.headline: Basarnas And Regional Authorities Increase Disaster Preparedness
aiSummaryBullets: Basarnas has deployed personnel and held readiness assemblies in multiple regions including Riau Islands, Semarang, and Kendari.
National and regional agencies are implementing strategies to mitigate risks related to the rainy season, such as floods and landslides.

clusters.headline: Arif Kurniawan Named In Treason Probe Following Nickel Money Laundering
aiSummaryBullets: The Attorney General's Office has designated businessman Arif Kurniawan as a suspect in a money laundering case related to illegal nickel mining.
The head of Bakom RI identified Arif Kurniawan as a primary suspect for an alleged plot to subvert the Prabowo administration.

clusters.headline: KPK Expands Corruption Probes In Klaten And ATR BPN Investigations
aiSummaryBullets: The KPK is investigating allegations of honorarium misuse involving members of the Klaten DPRD and regional officials.
Investigators summoned the Head of the Mojokerto Land Office and the spouse of a senior ATR BPN official regarding a bribery case.

clusters.headline: Prabowo Subianto Oversees Destruction Of 601 Tons Of Narcotics
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto oversaw the state-sanctioned destruction of 601.7 tons of confiscated narcotics.
The event included reports on police operations against illicit substances and online fraud syndicates.

clusters.headline: Shin Tae-yong Prepares Persija Jakarta For Upcoming League Matches
aiSummaryBullets: Persija Jakarta manager Shin Tae-yong is emphasizing strong preparation for upcoming Super League fixtures.
The team recently secured a 7-0 victory against Sumsel United, though the coach noted fatigue during that period.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Provinces And Cities Finalize 2027 Minimum Wage Rates
aiSummaryBullets: Regional governments have finalized 2027 minimum wage figures, including specific adjustments for cities like Depok, Surabaya, and Bengkulu.
South Kalimantan has set its 2027 provincial minimum wage at approximately Rp4.05 million, marking an 8.87 percent increase.

clusters.headline: Polda Metro Jaya Evaluasi Keamanan Aksi Mahasiswa Dan Berantas Narkoba
aiSummaryBullets: Polda Metro Jaya berkomitmen mengevaluasi prosedur pengamanan unjuk rasa setelah menerima keberatan dari pihak mahasiswa Universitas Indonesia.
Komjen Dadang Hartanto menegaskan bahwa pemberantasan narkoba dan perjudian daring menjadi prioritas utama pihak kepolisian.

clusters.headline: Iran Denies Involvement In Drone Strike That Killed Two In Kuwait
aiSummaryBullets: Two Italian citizens were killed during an attack on a vital facility in Kuwait.
Iranian military leadership officially denied responsibility for the drone strike.

clusters.headline: Harga Emas Antam Bertahan di Level Rp2,501 Juta per Gram Hari Ini
aiSummaryBullets: Harga emas batangan produksi PT Aneka Tambang Tbk tidak mengalami perubahan dan tetap berada di level Rp2.501.000 per gram pada Jumat.
Nilai buyback atau harga pembelian kembali emas oleh perusahaan tercatat mengalami kenaikan sebesar Rp3.000 per gram dibandingkan sebelumnya.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Nationals Prevented From Joining Russian Military Forces
aiSummaryBullets: Two Indonesian citizens were prevented from leaving the country at Surabaya airport.
Authorities identified the individuals as candidates allegedly recruited to serve as mercenaries for Russia.

clusters.headline: Perum Bulog Receives National Recognition For Food Security Efforts
aiSummaryBullets: Perum Bulog was honored with the 2026 Anugerah Bhakti Nusantara award for its role in national food security.
The state agency continues to focus on stabilizing rice supplies across Indonesia to ensure consistent food availability.
